name: sample_logic
summary: Watch up to 32 logic values for up to 30 s; answers their first readings and every change with its time. Read only.

help.text: Samples every interval_seconds (default 0.5) for duration_seconds (default 5), at most 120 samples. The game takes each sample in the first frame at or after it is due, so an interval shorter than a frame yields fewer samples than asked; sample_count says how many it took.

logic_type.description: A logic type name (Temperature) or number.

targets.description: Values to watch, up to 32, each {reference_id, logic_type}.

duration_seconds.description: How long to watch; default 5, max 30.
